summary: This clinical study tested a drug called TERN-601 in adults who are overweight or have obesity. A placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the drug, was also used for comparison. The trial has a Completed status and involved 167 participants. Terns, Inc., a subsidiary of Merck & Co., Inc. (Rahway, New Jersey USA) served as the sponsor for this Phase 2 research.
